basic_info.description: Location, Location, Location Seeing to appreciate!  Beautiful Single Family Home with all natural light thru out 3+1 bedrooms 2 Full Bathrooms approximately 1,640 sq. ft. 2 story building with spacious entrance. Enjoy the Sunset Views look over the upper bedrooms features all 2 bedrooms at upper level with one of the bedrooms connected to Closet/Bathroom.  Completely remodeled Kitchen and Lower Unit in the year 2017. Freshly painted interior. Formal dining Room with all double pane windows & original hardwood floors. Spacious level backyard with a beautiful Camilla Tree & Succulents at the front yard.    Enjoy a truly wonderful old-world charm closed to Schools, Parks, Commercial Strips, Restaurants and Groceries along Noriega St. as well as Taraval St.
